title: Azerbaijan Democratic Republic
capsule: The Azerbaijan Democratic Republic, proclaimed in May 1918, was the first secular democratic republic in the Muslim world, governing from Ganja and then Baku amid the chaos of the Russian Civil War. It was extinguished in April 1920 when the Red Army invaded and incorporated it into Soviet rule.
